# Default Bionic driver archive

`Turnip-a6xx-a7xx-a8xx.zip` is the exact pinned archive mirrored in the
[x11-extras-20261025 component release](https://github.com/HezeAI/termux-jobs-components/releases/tag/x11-extras-20261025).
It is retained here for reproducible integrity checks and provenance; it is not
included in APK assets. The application downloads it only for the deferred
built-in driver selection when needed.

Distribution credit: **StevenMXZ**. Original metadata identifies GameHub and
Mesa26.3.0-devel-b00479181d. Only the metadata display name was changed; the
library bytes remain unchanged. This imported Bionic driver is separate from
the application's Mesa26.2.5 Turnip/Zink and bridge frontend. The filename is not
a guarantee of support for every Adreno generation. Sources/licenses and the
limits of upstream provenance are recorded in the
[components overview](https://github.com/HezeAI/termux-jobs-components#readme).
Exact archive/library hashes and metadata are in `provenance.json`.
